Name: Pikmin Crop Pack (outdated)
Author: ZoomyDoomy
Description:
[size=3][i]!!!DOES NOT CURRENTLY WORK WITH RECENT UPDATE!!!

This crop pack adds the cute and lovable pikmin as a harvestable crop![/i]

Each type of pikmin can be grown in different seasons

-Red, Yellow and Blue pikmin can be grown in spring
-White and Purple pikmin can be grown in summer
-Pink and Rock pikmin can be grown in Fall
-Ice and Glow pikmin can be grown in winter

[b][u]Heads up: Spacecore will be required for the winter crops to work.[/u][/b]

If you're ready, come pluck some new friends![/size]

Downloads.Description: The whole file itself, download to your stardew mods folder.
